name: Betty Petersen Conservation Fund
summary: BirdsCaribbean fund for community conservation projects that protect birds and habitats in the Caribbean. The fund supports individuals and Caribbean-headquartered organisations working with local communities.
reporting: Awardees submit a report to the BirdsCaribbean Grant Committee one year after the project starts and write a blog article; two-year projects require a second annual report.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are invited from Individuals or organizations headquartered in the Caribbean (e.g., Undergraduate Students, Masters Students, Doctoral Students, Postdoctoral, Early Professionals, Established Professionals, Non-Professionals, Organizations/Governments).

geography.quote: The Betty Petersen Conservation Fund seeks to advance the conservation status of birds and habitats in the Caribbean region through projects that engage and empower communities and stakeholders to protect and benefit sustainably from their birds.

access.quote: Check our pages, blog post and social media for announcements of when the fund is open for grant applications & for details of how to apply.

reporting.quote: Awardees will be required to submit a report to the BirdsCaribbean's Grant Committee one year from the project start date, and a blog article about this work for our broader community. Two-year projects require a second annual report.
